notes.title: Patch 11.23
notes.content:
Hello together,

Besides working on the landscapes for Act 2 to Act 9, I made some changes to the game mechanics, which are now live and can be tested.

-Add Wwise to the project.
-Add a combat armor which build up piece by piece on the character, higher your combos goes more pieces will appear and increase the damage to the attacks.
-Adjust the jump button of the gamepad for better air controls.
-Adjust the stamina consumption of dodging from 50 to 5 in the tactical movement mode and in the normal mode from 60 to 20.
-Adjust the animation speed of attacks when hitting enemies.

notes.title: Heart in the Dark What is NEW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031326/3ef49dc06a26b77ff88ae6cbca620d5f0c2f22b1.png[/img]

Hey out there I changed and integrated the following...

- Stamina regeneration and  the counter of the actions Leonidon makes
- In air Leonidon can now glide and expand his air time 
- Charged attack on the ground 
- Expand air attack combo for all elements
- New Start-Screen 
- Teleport logic is reworked for expanded air combat 

What comes next:
I will work on the story and quest logic and will draw the needed story elements and characters

Try it out now for FREE in the Playtest 55 places are only available or support my work with buying the early access version it means everything to me

I wish you an awesome and healthy time...

notes.title: Shorty Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36031326/e2bbbdabb1b9a4a9cec4692edeb98ce0b2990005.png[/img]Hello,

Leonidon now gets experience points for each destroyed enemy, if he redeems the spirit of the enemy he gets additional experience points.
With the Char key you get to the menu where you can invest your points in strength, endurance or life.

If you are in the homeworld Dahuam there is a time vacuum, which freezes the world balance.
Some changes have been made to the design in the worlds.

I wish u a good time
